**Finding: missing** (medium severity) — no post-termination transition assistance or data-return obligation exists in the Agreement.

What I verified:
- **Section 10 (Effect of Expiry or Termination)** only ends access "after any agreed transition period" (§10.1) and covers Deliverable delivery and refunds (§10.2) — no obligation on Vendor to provide assistance or return data.
- **Section 15 (Customer Data and Privacy)** governs processing limits only; no return, export, or deletion mechanic.
- **Section 16.5** defers Customer Data to "Sections 11 and 15" — but **Section 11 does not exist** in the document, so the cross-reference is a dead end.
- Text searches for "transition", "export", "delet", and "machine-readable" surfaced nothing else usable.

This fails both the preferred and the fallback position (no assistance period, no export window, no certified deletion), so I inserted a new §10.3 at the preferred position: up to six months' assistance at then-current rates, Customer Data returned in machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter (with routine backup/legal retention carve-out to keep it acceptable to Vendor). The 90-day fallback is flagged in the negotiation comment.
